answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly, like a tide returning across an ocean: the stake is only spendable after many epochs of honest, peer-attested work, so a Sybil farm must fund every fake separately and wait out the same long horizon before any of them pays. Slashing burns the stake of any identity caught lying, turning each fake into a velvet-lined trap — cheap to enter, ruinous to abuse — so spawning thousands costs thousands of locked stakes with no shortcut.
